mechanics_assumptions: Canonical story-mode species and order are preserved in Original teams mode

Regional campaign levels are normalized to the shared 10-to-100 progression

source.variant: Canonical Gym/Trial, Elite Four and Champion story rosters
source.compatibility_note: Story rosters are presented in the current NatDex Draft battle format.
